peerReviewedCopepodVoucherCrosscheck.studyScope: Cyclopoid copepods in UST-ZRC freshwater samples; not fish.
peerReviewedCopepodVoucherCrosscheck.supports: A separate peer-reviewed article reports site-specific copepod voucher records at a locality printed as Lake Tambo, Santa Juliana, Tarlac. Its coordinate is essentially the same rounded sampling point reported by the 2017 nationwide microcrustacean checklist; the papers may draw on overlapping UST-ZRC collections, so they are not treated as independent field surveys.
doesNotSupport: a lake boundary, CRS, or coordinate accuracy
peerReviewedCopepodVoucherCrosscheck.caveat: The 2017 and 2018 articles may use overlapping UST-ZRC material; separate publications do not establish independent collecting events.

synthesis.namesAsReported: The DENR-BMB 2016 Atlas lists Tambo Lake in Capas; the Capas charter places Tambo Lake under Barangay Sta. Juliana; and two separate peer-reviewed microcrustacean studies print Lake Tambo in Santa Juliana, Tarlac. This strongly supports Tambo Lake / Lake Tambo as a name/locality variant for the Capas/Sta. Juliana lake, while a canonical gazetteer identifier and field-verified identity remain unset.
synthesis.geometry: No authoritative or field-verified boundary was found. The BMB 2016 approximate area of 91.98 ha is locality/area context only; it does not supply geometry. The community-mapped OSM outline candidate remains unapproved; its 79.37 ha estimate and the published copepod coordinate near/outside its edge remain unreconciled.
synthesis.fishEvidence: The targeted web and GBIF screens found no eligible Tambo Lake fish survey, fish specimen record, or taxon-resolved catch record. The site-specific published taxa are copepods, and PNA sources report stocking only. Do not infer fish absence or create fish inventory rows from these bounded negative results.
synthesis.sanMarcosLake: No new locality, survey, or geometry evidence for San Marcos Lake was found; retain the prior PNA stocking-only lead unchanged.

nextActions: Continue searching independently indexed university repository theses, peer-reviewed freshwater fish studies, museum/GBIF/OBIS records, and historical field reports for Tambo Lake / Capas; admit only taxon-resolved fish evidence with locality-level linkage and traceable source records.
Seek an authoritative or independently surveyed shoreline with date, datum, and method; do not substitute the atlas approximate area or OSM candidate for geometry.
Keep stocking, copepod vouchers, and informal travel-narrative fish labels outside a verified fish inventory; keep Central Luzon and Luzon incomplete.
